items.defectStatement: Age-based annotation cleanup, count-based cleanup, and orphaned-tag cleanup unconditionally emit error-level logs for successful batches, including full ID lists and a known-nil fetch error. This floods error logs with normal cleanup activity and obscures actual failures.
obligations: Remove or downgrade routine success logs in all three cleanup flows so successful batches emit no error-level entries.
Remove known-nil error fields and avoid dumping full ID lists at normal operational log levels.
Preserve batch deletion, affected-row accounting, and propagation of actual errors.
items.notes: The anchor covers only age-based cleanup; the finding also requires changes at lines 554/557 and 576/579. Removing the diagnostic logs is valid. The post-delete error y can be non-nil, unlike the pre-delete err.
